title: cosys: packages and Lean 4 proofs for Collaboration Is Composition and What Absence Costs
description: The packages that implement a model of collaboration in which every party acts through a Mealy machine over an append-only log of signed records, and the Lean 4 proofs of two papers: Collaboration Is Composition: Mealy Machines over Signed Records in Poly and Org, and What Absence Costs, on which social facts need an authority. The proofs are in proofs/, in the libraries CosysCore, CosysCalco and CosysSocial; proofs/Check.lean prints the axioms behind each result.
